title: [finding] main's lockfile matches two new OSV advisories (sharp 0.35.4 GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w high, fixed in 0.35.5; shell-quote 1.10.0 GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv critical, fixed in 1.11.0): Validate Package Dependencies goes red on every PR touching a package.json
body:
Filing gate: ① a reproducible defect — `main`'s lockfile matches two OSV advisories that have fixed releases, so the repo's own gate `Validate Package Dependencies` (`.github/workflows/validate-deps.yml`, step "Audit dependencies for known vulnerabilities (OSV-Scanner)") is red for every PR that touches a `package.json`, and will be red on the next 03:00Z scheduled scan. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287, `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE`) because PR #22002 (#21959) inherits the red. ⛔ Not graded or routed here (precedent #21945 → `domain:devx`). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ No dependency is changed by this lane.
Reader: triage first-touch → the lane that owns the lockfile (precedent #21945, fixed by PR #21951 in `domain:devx`); the fix is one lockfile PR.
Dedupe: `search_issues` (objectstack, open + closed): "OSV scanner advisory lockfile sharp shell-quote GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv Validate Package Dependencies red" → 21 hits, the OSV family (#21945, #21055, #20769, #20705, #20561, #18930, #14732), all closed, none naming sharp or shell-quote; REST `GET /issues?state=all&since=2026-10-06T12:00Z` → no OSV-shaped title. Control: the same query returns #21945 (this morning's four advisories) first, so the instrument reaches the family.

## What is measured

- **The red run.** PR #22002 run 37483796939 (job 112338516653) on head `95c510eb`, started 2026-10-06T15:01Z. Every step before the scanner passed (frozen-lockfile install, the Changesets fixed group, the overrides, the vendor-export contract, the OSV-exemption ledger). The scanner's verdict: "Total 2 packages affected by 2 known vulnerabilities (1 Critical, 1 High) … 2 vulnerabilities can be fixed":
  - `sharp` 0.35.4 → fixed in 0.35.5 — GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w (CVSS 8.9, High). Resolution comes from the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` override for the sharp 0.34–0.35 range, whose target is `^0.35.4` (line 329 at `f0022c46`); the lockfile resolves `sharp@0.35.4` (two workspace importers, lockfile lines 14592 and 14619).
  - `shell-quote` 1.10.0 → fixed in 1.11.0 — GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv (CVSS 9.2, Critical). `pnpm why shell-quote`: `shell-quote@1.10.0` ← `launch-editor@2.14.1` ← `@changesets/cli@3.0.3` (a root devDependency). No override names it today.
- **Not the PR's.** PR #22002 changes no dependency: its only `package.json` edit removes one `scripts` line (`check:pm-widening-tells`), which is what triggered the path-filtered workflow; `pnpm-lock.yaml` is untouched by it.
- **Timing.** The last lockfile change on `main` is `f0022c46` (#21991, merged 2026-10-06T14:07Z), whose own PR run of this workflow was green at 13:24Z. Nothing else touched the lockfile since; the two advisories were therefore published between 13:24Z and 15:01Z, and `main` is red by the same reading before the scheduled scan has seen it.

## Done when

- `main`'s lockfile resolves `sharp` at or above 0.35.5 and `shell-quote` at or above 1.11.0 — the override target lifted for sharp (the selector's upper bound already sits above the target's version line), and an override or a `@changesets/cli` bump for shell-quote — in the shape of PR #21951; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` green; the OSV step green on the fixing PR.
- No exemption: both advisories have fixed releases, and `osv-scanner.toml` is for no-fix advisories only.
- After it lands, PR #22002 gets an `update-branch` so its workflow re-runs on the fixed base (a re-run of the old run reads the same lockfile).
